subject: Re: Co-hosted Booth, Collateral Exchange & Speaker Ops
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@summitworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: SummitWorks Ops <ops@summitworks.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-hosted booth & speaker ops — details and collateral needed

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the NorthStack booth with SummitWorks at NorthStack 2025. A few operational items we still need to lock before the expo hall opens: 

1) Collateral specs: we need a print-ready sponsor one-pager (8.5x11 PDF) and a 1920x1080 hero image for the booth screen by Sept 12 to hit our print deadlines.
2) Booth split: we assigned Redwood 6 linear feet of the island space and SummitWorks 4 feet. Can you confirm which product demo you want visible on the Redwood side and whether you’ll need A/V time beyond the shared 20-min slot each day?
3) Speaker slot: we tentatively hold the 11:30am breakout on Day 2. Please confirm speaker name, headshot, and a 100-word blurb by Sept 10.
4) Collateral exchange: can you share any giveaway quantities and whether Redwood will ship pre-packaged kits to our warehouse? 

I attached our standard co-host memo of agreement (MOA) and a booth blueprint — please review and flag any redlines. Once we have the signed MOA we’ll issue the final exhibitor credentials and a DocuSign for the inbound shipping label.

Attachments: MOA_SummitWorks_v1.pdf (memo), BoothBlueprint.png

If it helps, I can book a 30-min ops call Friday to walk through logistics.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Partnerships Manager, SummitWorks
lina@summitworks.com
415-555-0189

--
SummitWorks Events — staging partners for NorthStack 2025
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@summitworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted booth & speaker ops — details and collateral needed

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Marissa (events lead) and Karthik (field marketing ops) to pick up the logistics. Quick answers below and we’ll follow with the files + redlines: 

- Collateral: we can deliver a print-ready sponsor one-pager and the hero image. Targeting Sept 11 delivery to give you a day buffer.
- Booth split/demos: Redwood will run a product demo of our "Low-Latency Inference" flow on the left 6-foot side; SummitWorks demos fine on the right. We don’t need extra A/V time beyond the shared slot but will bring a spare laptop for handoff.
- Speaker: Confirming Isabella Park as our speaker for the 11:30am Day 2 slot. Karthik — can you capture headshot + 100-word blurb and drop into the Drive link?
- Giveaways/shipping: Redwood will ship 500 branded notebooks and 300 2oz trial credits cards. We prefer to ship to your warehouse if you can confirm inbound label details.

We saw the MOA and have an internal redline; Marissa, Karthik — please add comments to the attached Draft_MOA.docx and SponsorCollateral_v2.pdf. Lina, if there are any material items in your MOA we should escalate to legal, flag those sections and we’ll fast-track.

Happy to do the ops call Friday 11am PT if that works for you.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@summitworks.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted booth & speaker ops — details and collateral needed

Hi Lina/Priyom — thanks for the notes. I reviewed the MOA and added tracked comments; summary of the operational asks below: 

- Print/artwork: we will provide SponsorCollateral_v2.pdf and BoothHero_1920x1080.png by end of day Sept 11. Files will be in the Google Drive folder (link below). Please confirm bleed requirements if different from standard US print (0.125in).
- Shipping: Redwood will pre-package kits (500 notebooks, 300 credit cards plus 50 spare media kits). Karthik, please confirm whether the 50 spares should be boxed with the primary shipment or sent separately to the show manager. Lina, can we get the inbound receiving window and warehouse address?
- On-site staffing: Redwood will staff the booth Day 1 (2 people), Day 2 (3 people incl. speaker prep), Day 3 (2 people). We request one dedicated staff parking pass per day if available.
- Speaker assets: Karthik will upload Isabella Park_headshot.jpg and Isabella_Park_100word.txt to the Drive by Sept 9.
- A/V: We need HDMI + ambient mic for the demo laptop. If SummitWorks provides the shared AV rack, we request a 10-minute setup window 30 mins before each demo block.

Attachments referenced: Draft_MOA.docx (internal redlines), SponsorCollateral_v2.pdf (artwork preview), BoothBlueprint.png

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Hk-example-link

I can join the Friday 11am PT ops call and will bring the final ship manifest.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Lina Gomez <lina@summitworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, SummitWorks Ops <ops@summitworks.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted booth & speaker ops — details and collateral needed

Thanks all — this is perfect. A few follow-ups after reviewing your redlines and assets: 

1) Warehouse: inbound delivery window Sept 20-22, warehouse address and dock hours included in the attached shipping instructions PDF. We prefer all kits boxed together; one pallet is ideal.
2) MOA: legal accepted your redlines except Section 4.3 (logo placement priority). We propose a compromise: Redwood logo will be primary on the right-facing panel of the island and SummitWorks logo will remain on top of the demo backdrop. If that works, we’ll push the final MOA through DocuSign.
3) Speaker: received Isabella's headshot and blurb — scheduled in the 11:30am Day 2 slot. Please confirm Isabella will arrive at least 45 mins before her session for mic check.
4) DocuSign: sending final MOA for signature now (link sent separately).

Attachments: shipping_instructions_northstack.pdf, final_MOA_for_signature.pdf

See you all on Friday’s call at 11am PT.

Best,
Lina
Lina Gomez
Partnerships Manager, SummitWorks
